item.title: GovBrief Today #542
item.description: The Pentagon told Congress that the war it has been fighting since February started three weeks ago. That bought another 60 days of fighting before anyone in Congress can stop it. The books got adjusted this weekend. A second file opened in the casualty record, the dead and wounded were split between two wars that are actually one war, and a count that said 482 Americans hurt since February now adds up to at least 624. Nearly a hundred troops were wounded after the shooting started again, and the Pentagon says those were mostly minor concussions. Six years ago, Iranian missiles injured more than a hundred troops, and Trump said they had headaches and were not seriously hurt. The Army denied their Purple Hearts while he was president. They were honored after he was gone. I've emailed 8,392 stories over 542 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you.
